items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Louis [Armstrong] was playing there with King Oliver

ctx.x: I just made these Kid Ory records, and I was taking them back to Chicago to try to get sales for 'em, you know--trying to promote the record, and when I got to Chicago, Louis [Armstrong] was playing there with King Oliver, and I met him and everything, and he said, "Well, Reb, one of these days, I'm going to be on a record. I'm going to try to make a record." He had never made a record.
And I showed you the letter I wrote him, and it was lost in the airplane.
